channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: PGA of America announces marketing executive Terry Clark as new CEO
item.description: The PGA of America named marketing executive Terry Clark the association’s chief executive officer on Wednesday.

item.title: Past champ Fowler's advice for extreme 16th
item.description: Rickie Fowler, a past champion at the WM Phoenix Open, loves extreme sports and loves extreme golf. He offers up his advice on playing the par-3 16th at TPC Scottsdale.

item.title: ASU duo gets invites to Augusta National Women's Am
item.description: Arizona State's Patience Rhodes and Beth Coulter join "Golf Today" at TPC Scottsdale to talk about their invites to this year's Augusta National Women's Amateur.

item.title: Jon Rahm echoes LIV's frustration with OWGR decision: 'We're not being treated the same'
item.description: Rahm said it's 'fantastic' that LIV Golf is getting world ranking points, but he adds that the decision to award only the top 10 could see players actually lose points.

item.title: Theegala: Ready for Phoenix crowds, wants golf with LeBron
item.description: Sahith Theegala nearly won the WM Phoenix Open and is ready to redeem himself. He also wouldn't mind playing a round with LeBron James (and, neither would Damon Hack).

item.title: Nice shot, Chief! Kelce nearly aces 16th at rowdy Scottsdale
item.description: Travis Kelce, Kansas City Chiefs tight end and Taylor Swift's fiancé, nearly jarred his tee shot on the par-3 16th at a raucous TPC Scottsdale. He then celebrated the birdie in classic fashion.

item.title: Travis Kelce ignites WM Phoenix Open crowd with brilliant tee shot, birdie putt on 16
item.description: The three-time Super Bowl champion tight end won the gold WM chain after putting his tee shot within a few feet of the hole and finishing it off with a birdie putt (and massive celebration).

item.title: Scottie Scheffler reflects on first win on Tour at WM Phoenix Open
item.description: Scottie Scheffler talks with Golf Channel's Ryan Lavner about how he self evaluates after tournaments. He also reflects on his first Tour victory at the WM Phoenix Open and what it meant to his career.

item.title: Brooks on Phoenix return: Golf course suits my eye
item.description: Brooks Koepka explains why TPC Scottsdale is a good fit for his game. Koepka also spoke about the work he's been doing to improve his putting since last weekend's Farmers Insurance Open.

item.title: 'Start season with a bang' at TPC Scottsdale: Clark
item.description: U.S. Open champion Wyndham Clark talked with Golf Channel about his meltdown at Oakmont Country Club last year and what he learned from the experience. Amid talk about the PGA Tour schedule, Clark vocalized support of starting the season at the WM Phoenix Open.
